Fed & Policy Watch
  • The Oct 27-28 FOMC meeting is past. The Board calendar schedules minutes for Nov 18 at 2:00 PM ET; it is a minutes release, not a policy decision. The next meeting is shown on the FOMC calendar for Dec 8-9; the forward calendar does not specify decision or press-conference times.
  • Today, ECI is at 8:30 AM; H.8 and H.15 are scheduled at 4:15 PM under their own Board calendar date lists. Next week, Chicago Fed NFCI is scheduled Wed Nov 4 at 8:30 AM for the week ending Oct 30; this corrects the prior briefing's Nov 6 date. H.4.1 is scheduled Thu Nov 5 at 4:30 PM.
  • Official liquidity observations are lagged: SOFR 3.94% effective Oct 28; NFCI -0.487 for the week ending Oct 23. Read together with MOVE 93.54 and the 10-year Treasury close at 4.98%, these are context measures, not real-time funding or rate quotes.
Omissions and Watch
  • Date/event conflict check: New York Fed, Census and BEA calendars agree on Nov 4 at 8:30 AM for September international trade; the New York Fed and Chicago Fed schedules place NFCI on Nov 4 at 8:30 AM for week ending Oct 30. New York Fed and Board release calendars agree on the dates/times used for BLS and Fed statistical items. BLS.gov was not requested; BLS dates/times are sourced to New York Fed. The Oct 29 GDP and PCE events are elapsed at the cutoff and excluded. No unresolved conflict among checked overlapping releases.
  • Chicago Fed lists its Labor Market Indicators October preliminary release on Oct 29 at 8:30 AM (elapsed) and final release on Nov 5 at 8:30 AM. CFNAI's Sept 2026 advance release was Oct 26 at 8:30 AM (elapsed). Chicago Fed's calendar confirms NFCI is Nov 4, not Oct 30 or Nov 6. No elapsed event appears in the calendar tables.
  • TreasuryDirect's returned upcoming-auction records verify 13- and 26-week bills closing Nov 2 at 11:30 AM and a 6-week bill closing Nov 3 at 11:30 AM. No future coupon-auction record was returned, so no note auction is inferred. The Board statistical-release calendar is represented selectively; routine Commercial Paper entries are omitted. EIA confirms the next petroleum report is Nov 12 at noon for week ending Nov 6, and natural-gas storage is Nov 13 at 10:30 AM; no EIA release is scheduled for today or Nov 2-6 in the checked schedules.
  • Checked date-specific sources: New York Fed Oct/Nov indicators calendars; Federal Reserve Board Oct/Nov calendars and FOMC calendar; BEA, Census, Chicago Fed, TreasuryDirect, EIA petroleum and natural gas schedules. New York Fed dates/times are tentative. No verified unscheduled geopolitical or policy watch item from this run; this is not a full risk review. No exchange-specific market-structure event or product-hours verification was available.
  • Yahoo is a single-source vendor quote for market snapshot fields. Futures are generic continuous-series observations, not official settlements. Reconfirm live event/auction updates, market depth, trading hours and selected contract before execution.
Trading Strategy Note | ES Futures
BASE CASE
SPY's Thu close fell 0.38%, while ES=F is 0.93% below Thursday's completed bar in the early Friday quote. The official 10Y close eased 7 bp to 4.98%; MOVE at 93.54 remains in the moderate-uncertainty band and VIX is 17.20. ECI is due at 8:30 AM, followed by New York Fed inflation trend data at 10:00 AM. Treat early price discovery and yield response as event-sensitive; wait for live rates, volatility and liquidity confirmation. Scenario framing only, not a trade signal.
INVALIDATION
Reassess if ES extends the overnight move without confirmation from Treasury yields, volatility or market depth; if ECI or subsequent data materially reprices rates; or if the selected contract's hours/liquidity differ. No unsupported levels or targets are supplied. Verify contract, event updates and fresh quotes before execution.
